# POKROV

Last updated: 2026-06-01

POKROV is an app-first connectivity product for Android and Windows. The public beta flow is simple: install the app, start 5 days free without a card, connect from the app, then manage duration, devices, recovery, and support through the cabinet.

## Canonical URLs

- Public site: https://pokrov.space/
- Install help: https://pokrov.space/install/
- Pricing and checkout continuation: https://pokrov.space/checkout/
- Cabinet: https://app.pokrov.space/
- API: https://api.pokrov.space/
- Connection delivery host for explicit manual recovery: https://connect.pokrov.space/

## Product facts

- Brand: POKROV
- Public beta platforms: Android and Windows
- Trial: 5 days free, no card required
- Telegram reward: +10 days after account linking and channel check
- Paid plans: up to 5 devices, depending on plan
- Free fallback after trial: monthly limited base mode
- Support: cabinet, support bot, and support email

## Release honesty

The current public beta is outside-store for Android and Windows. Do not describe POKROV as store-published, stable 1.0.0, trusted-signed on Windows, or production-mature beyond the evidence on the public site and official documentation.
